title: Tallest Billboard
summary: Given a collection of rods with various lengths, determine the largest possible height for two equal steel supports to install a billboard by welding the rods together.
statement: Given a collection of rods with various lengths, determine the largest possible height for two equal steel supports to install a billboard by welding the rods together. If it is not possible to create the supports, return 0.
constraints: Assign each rod to the left support, right support, or unused.
Return the greatest equal support height.
hints: Represent a partial assignment by height difference and the shorter support height.
For each rod, skip it, add it to taller, or add it to shorter.
Update difference and shorter height from a frozen copy of states.
The state retains exactly the information needed for all future balancing choices.
editorial: The state retains exactly the information needed for all future balancing choices.

No positive equal split exists, so the height is zero.
